items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: At that time Punch, Chani was playin' with Papa Salisbury.

ctx.x: When did Chani play with Punch? Before you or after?

Oh, I don't remember. At that time Punch, Chani was playin' with Papa Salisbury. At that time, yeah. He must have played after, maybe afterwards. That's a guy who had a big reputation. Don't know how he could go back at it. He played good drums. What Chani would be? Oh, he was a good drummer.

items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: And I have a brother that's now playing with the, with our Papa Selle's Dance Band, on the direction of Edith Pearson.

ctx.x: Your father's name is? Is it John Barberang. How many brothers do you have?

I have a brother we just lost about a year or so ago. His name is Lucien Barberang. He died. And I have a brother that's now playing with the, with our Papa Selle's Dance Band, on the direction of Edith Pearson. His name is Lewis Barberang. Then I have another brother that plays a pretty good trumpet. But I don't know, he, he just rather work in there, before working in the daytime, and fooling with the trumpet, I guess, I don't know.
